summary: Comprehensive E2E test of NEGOTIA iteration 2 (neomorphic redesign + SSE streaming + Voice STT/TTS + RU/EN language switcher). Backend pytest suite: 18/18 pass (health, auth, register, scenarios (12, hidden fields scrubbed), frameworks (4), prep autofill, negotiation create, SSE stream with proper user→ai_start→ai_chunk→ai_end→done sequence, legacy message, end with score/skills/feedback, voice transcribe empty->400 + WAV->200, voice tts empty->400 + EN mp3>=1KB + RU mp3>=1KB, user stats, framework stats, coach hint). Frontend smoke: login → dashboard → scenarios (12 cards, filter pills) → history → profile (radar + strengths/weaknesses + framework breakdown) → negotiation room (participants sidebar with trust/pressure meters, live signals, message sent with SSE typing-caret .typing-caret confirmed rendering, btn-mic present, btn-voice-toggle present). Body background is #FAF9F6, no #0B0F17 dark remnants. AppShell testids all present (brand-link, nav-*, lang-switch, user-menu).

minor.issue: Response is wrapped in {negotiation:{...}} (outcome/score/skill_scores are nested under negotiation.feedback or negotiation itself). Confirmed working, just nested; ensure Debrief.jsx unwraps consistently.
Response is wrapped as {preparation:{...}} with keys batna/priorities/theirs/offer/opening/close (6 keys — different keys than review spec listed but 6 present).
Response is wrapped in {negotiation:{...}}. framework_name is populated inside negotiation object. Verify frontend unwraps correctly (SimulationWizard, Room).

integration_issues.flow: i18n / language switcher on all pages
integration_issues.issue: Many Russian strings are hardcoded and NOT routed through I18nProvider. When lang=EN, the following pages still render Russian text: (a) Dashboard/History recent-simulation status pill 'В процессе' (should be 'In progress'), (b) NegotiationRoom sidebar: 'Оппоненты' (Opponents), 'Доверие' (Trust), 'Давление' (Pressure), 'Ваша подготовка' (Your Preparation), 'LIVE-СИГНАЛЫ' (Live Signals), 'Сделайте первый ход.' (Make the first move), 'Подготовка не заполнена.' (Preparation not filled), (c) Profile: 'Эффективность по методологиям' (Framework Performance), 'Зона роста: SPIN' (Growth Area: SPIN). This breaks the RU/EN switcher promise for these components.

issues: Neomorphic style is consistently applied. No #0B0F17 remnants found. Body bg = rgb(250,249,246) = #FAF9F6 as expected. Plus Jakarta Sans + JetBrains Mono in use.

sse_and_voice_verified.sse_stream: PASS — SSE event ordering (user → ai_start → ai_chunk×N → ai_end → done) confirmed via requests iter_lines. Content-Type is text/event-stream. done payload contains state. UI shows .typing-caret element while streaming — verified via DOM query.
sse_and_voice_verified.voice_stt: PASS — /api/voice/transcribe returns 400 on empty, 200 on silent WAV.
sse_and_voice_verified.voice_tts: PASS — /api/voice/tts returns 400 on empty, audio/mpeg >=1KB for both EN and RU text.
sse_and_voice_verified.voice_ui: btn-mic and btn-voice-toggle both present on NegotiationRoom in free mode (data-testids match spec).

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 883 lines — approaching 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, scenarios, negotiations, voice, coach).
Response wrapping is inconsistent — /negotiations returns {negotiation:{...}}, /prep returns {preparation:{...}}, /health returns flat. Standardize response envelope.
Many negotiation-room UI strings are hardcoded in Russian bypassing i18n — breaks EN mode.
STT endpoint uses OpenAISpeechToText SDK with try/except TypeError fallback — brittle. Consider adopting whichever API signature is stable in emergentintegrations.

Streaming endpoint updates doc[state] and then writes once at 'done'. If client disconnects mid-stream, message accumulates on client but never persists. Consider incremental updates or a finally-block persist.
seed_data_creation: None (test creates one TEST_ user via register and multiple negotiations under demo user — no cleanup needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green with new pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_negotia_api.py. All new SSE + Voice endpoints work. Only outstanding issue is i18n coverage: NegotiationRoom sidebar/signals, Dashboard/History status pill, and Profile framework-performance section contain hardcoded Russian text — needs to move to i18n keys. Response wrapping ({negotiation:{...}}, {preparation:{...}}) is intentional; frontend already handles it.
